Halekas, PhD is confirmed as Professor and Society of Physics Students (SPS) Advisor in the UIowa Department of Physics and Astronomy, with email jasper-halekas@uiowa.edu matching the lead; no namesake conflict surfaced. -> Use the UIowa faculty profile as canonical contact record.
- **One Competitive NASA Award In Scope (Aug 2024)**: A 1-year NASA award worth $1.495M to UIowa (PI Casey DeRoo) names Jasper Halekas as a co-investigator; the funded work builds the ACES instrument for TRACERS and also supports student training. -> Treat Halekas as co-I (not PI) on the only Aug 2024+ funding record I could verify from official pages.
- **Active Mission Roles, Not Competitive Grants**: UIowa assigns Halekas as instrument lead/scientist for MAVEN, Parker Solar Probe, and TRACERS, plus deputy PI for THEMIS-ARTEMIS and Lunar Vertex; these are institutional mission appointments, not personal grant awards. -> Do not misreport mission participation as new competitive grant funding.
- **No Currently Open Group Hiring Located**: A search of the UIowa jobs portal, the Physics and Astronomy news page, and the Space Physics group page returned no PhD/RA/research-staff/research-engineer posting on/after 2026-01-01 explicitly tied to Halekas or his group. -> Mark hiring as "No verified public evidence found" rather than fabricate openings.
- **No Personnel Posts Linked to Halekas on LinkedIn**: A LinkedIn people-search dataset returned zero matches for "Jasper Halekas"; no group-department LinkedIn post links him to a 2026 hiring ad. -> Use UIowa institutional pages as the corroborating source if any LinkedIn post emerges.

- **Patent-Level Identity Distinction Holds**: Search results for "Jasper Halekas" returned only the UIowa physicist; no other working physicist or instrument PI at a peer institution shares the name in indexed public profiles or awards. -> Identity confidence is high.
- **Confidence Limit on Detailed NSF/NSPIREC Records**: Direct extraction of NSF Award Search and NSPIRES award-owner views either returned the search-form shell or empty results; recoverable details (award numbers, full NSF abstract, ID) were not captured end-to-end. -> Acknowledge the gap and rely on the UIowa news article as the corroborated primary source for the 2024 award.
content.identity:
The lead points to Jasper Halekas at the University of Iowa Physics and Astronomy with email jasper-halekas@uiowa.edu, research in solar wind, lunar plasma, planetary magnetospheres, and instrumentation. All four identity attributes resolve cleanly against UIowa's official channels:

- **Full name and credential**: "Jasper S. Halekas, PhD" appears as the official heading on his departmental faculty page in the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences, with the title "Professor" and the additional duty "Society of Physics Students (SPS) Advisor" listed on the same page (https://physics.uiowa.edu/people/jasper-s-halekas). The local namespace "jasper-halekas" in the URL matches the lead email "jasper-halekas@uiowa.edu", so there is no risk of merging with another UIowa staff member.
- **Email and contact**: The lead-supplied email is the same as the local-part used in his departmental URL and is reproduced on his official profile page (https://physics.uiowa.edu/people/jasper-s-halekas). No public backup address on public web pages; the departmental page is the single source of truth.
- **Group and rank**: He is listed among the named researchers on the Space Physics area page alongside Howes, DeRoo, Gayley, Jaynes, Miles, Bounds, Christopher, Crawford, Faden, Granroth, Hartley, Hospodarsky, Kurth, McGinnis, Menietti, Pickett, Piker, Steele, and Wilkinson (https://physics.uiowa.edu/space-physics). Van Allen, Gurnett, and Hansen appear as pioneering/former members of the same group; none of them is confusable with the current Jasper Halekas.
- **Research focus alignment**: His profile bio states: "Jasper Halekas's research seeks to broaden our understanding of the impact of the Sun and the solar wind on our solar system and its evolution. To accomplish this, he designs and builds instruments to measure charged particles around moons and planets and in the interplanetary medium" (https://physics.uiowa.edu/people/jasper-s-halekas). This maps 1:1 to the lead's stated topics (solar wind, lunar plasma, planetary magnetospheres, instrumentation).
- **Active mission appointments (corroborating)**: Same profile names him as "instrument lead or scientist for particle sensors on MAVEN, Parker Solar Probe, and TRACERS; deputy PI for the THEMIS-ARTEMIS and Lunar Vertex missions" (https://physics.uiowa.edu/people/jasper-s-halekas). These are individually creditable facts the Space Physics page confirms by listing TRACERS, Parker Solar Probe, MAVEN, and Lunar Vertex instrumentation under the same instrument cluster (https://physics.uiowa.edu/space-physics).
- **Education**: PhD from the University of California, Berkeley, per the UIowa profile (https://physics.uiowa.edu/people/jasper-s-halekas).

No namesake conflict surfaced. "Jasper" as a standalone search token is dominated by the Jasper.ai marketing-tech company and by unrelated individuals (e.g., Jasper Reed at AWS, Jasper Mars in Iowa social work), but restricting to the full name with the UIowa / space-physics qualifying terms returns only this physicist.

Notes on the table:
- Row 1 is the only competitive grant I could verify as awarded on/after 2024-01-01 with Halekas as a named co-I; UIowa lists the funder specifically as "NASA's Safety, Security, and Mission Services division", while scientific scope is TRACERS/ACES. The award article explicitly names Casey DeRoo as PI and Allison Jaynes, Jasper Halekas, and David Miles as co-investigators.
- Row 2 is not a new competitive grant to Halekas personally; it is an institutional mission/program fact that the Space Physics page and his faculty profile use to describe his role. Some grant databases may record an ACES/PI sub-award; my direct NSPIRES `viewawardlist` calls returned empty.
- A Nov 2022 UIowa news item records $128,705 from the University of Minnesota / NASA for Parker Solar Probe data work by Halekas (https://physics.uiowa.edu/news/2022/11/halekas-awarded-grant-study-solar-wind). It predates the 2024 cutoff and is therefore cited as context only.
- The NSF Public Access Repository lists Halekas as an author and could imply prior NSF support (https://par.nsf.gov/search/author:%22Halekas%2C%20Jasper%20S.%22), but the NSF Award Search advanced-search URL returned only the search-form shell with no result rows extractable, so a per-award NSF record under his PI role for 2024+ is **not verified** in this research.

What was checked (and not found):
- NASA NSPIRES `viewawardlist` queries by PI name and PI ID returned empty/JS-only pages, so a full NSPIRES award-by-award breakdown for Halekas is **not verified**.
- NSF Award Search `advancedSearch.jsp` with `ActiveAwards=true` filtered to Jasper Halekas at University of Iowa returned the search form rather than a populated result table in this run; no specific 2024+ NSF award number, amount, dates, or abstract could be extracted from an official NSF record.
- Grantome searches for "jasper halekas" and "halekas iowa" returned the search-form shell only; no entries populated (https://grantome.com/search?q=jasper+halekas).
- NASA Techport's `author?lastName=Halekas&firstName=Jasper&organizationName=University of Iowa` returns a 404 page, so no Techport-listed technical reports could be cited (https://techport.nasa.gov/author?lastName=Halekas&firstName=Jasper).

Mechanism, implication, recommendation:
- The mechanism: UIowa funnels most of its competitive instrument-grant news through the departmental news page rather than funder press releases, so any post-2024 record depends on UIowa communications. Beyond the Aug 2024 piece, no parallel UIowa news article on Halekas personally as PI or co-I surfaced.
- Implication: For any record beyond the Aug 2024 NASA co-I award, plan to query NSPIRES with the verified PI ID (which I could not confirm end-to-end) and NSF Award Search by name + organization with the official `AwardSearch` URL.
- Recommendation: Cross-check with the project leads Casey DeRoo and Allison Jaynes: a multi-PI co-I grant on ACES will surface in news about either of them.

content.linkedin_evidence:
A LinkedIn people-search query targeting `Jasper Halekas` returned **zero rows** in the LinkedIn people dataset (query: first/last name "Jasper Halekas"). The LinkedIn domain also surfaces unrelated "Jasper" entities (the marketing-tech company Jasper.ai, Jasper Reed at AWS, Jasper Depuydt at KU Leuven). The departmental Facebook and Instagram handles widely cite UIowa news about him (e.g., https://www.instagram.com/p/C0zQLEPvuLt; https://www.facebook.com/physics.uiowa.edu/posts/3606499809380637), but these are not LinkedIn posts and do not advertise openings.

What was found vs. not found:
- **Personal LinkedIn profile for Jasper Halekas**: not located via the people dataset (zero rows). Search engines surfaced only namesakes and the UIowa faculty page that mirrors his bio (https://physics.uiowa.edu/people/jasper-s-halekas). No public LinkedIn URL is verified in this research.
- **LinkedIn posts by UIowa Department of Physics & Astronomy about Jasper Halekas's hiring**: The departmental LinkedIn page (https://www.linkedin.com/company/department-of-physics-astronomy-university-of-iowa) appears in search; no post advertising a Halekas-group opening on/after 2026-01-01 appeared.
- **LinkedIn posts by UIowa Research / CLAS about Jasper Halekas**: The UIowa Research and CLAS LinkedIn pages (http://linkedin.com/company/uiowaresearch; http://linkedin.com/company/university-of-iowa-clas) appear in search; no hiring or grant announcements by these accounts tied to Halekas surfaced in this run.

Mechanism, implication, recommendation:
- Mechanism: LinkedIn search on a single academic name is noisy unless the dataset has the exact profile slug; even if a profile exists, the API-ish vespa view does not always surface it. Facebook/Instagram posts about his work do surface because they explicitly name him.
- Implication: For incoming leads, the most reliable corroborating surfaces are UIowa institutional pages and news, not LinkedIn.
- Recommendation: Confirm any LinkedIn-hired position with the official `https://jobs.uiowa.edu/` posting URL before publishing; do not source hires solely from a LinkedIn post.
